user_query: I want to surprise my friends with a trivia night about climate change. Can you fetch articles from all newspapers to gather a wide range of questions? Additionally, I would like to know the search count and monthly data for the keyword 'climate change' to create challenging questions. Lastly, please recommend some local newspapers that cover environmental news for inspiration.

TaskList.description: Fetch articles from all newspapers related to climate change to gather questions for the trivia night.
Retrieve search count and monthly search data for the keyword 'climate change' to assess its popularity and difficulty.
Identify and recommend local newspapers that cover environmental news for additional inspiration.
